title: Cohere Embedding Function Schema
description: Schema for the Cohere embedding function configuration

model_name.description: The name of the model to use for document embeddings

api_key_env_var.description: Environment variable name that contains your API key for the Cohere API

query_model_name.description: Optional model to use for query embeddings. Must share an embedding space with model_name (e.g. embed-v5.0-pro and embed-v5.0-fast)

output_dimension.description: Optional embedding size for models with Matryoshka output (embed-v4.0 and newer)

input_type.description: Input type for document embeddings (set by the JS client)

truncate.description: How the API handles inputs longer than the model's context (set by the JS client)

embedding_type.description: Embedding type to return (set by the JS client)

image.description: Whether inputs are images (set by the JS client)
